fine_lines.title: direct vs indirect questions
words: Can you tell me where... is?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في السؤال المباشر يأتي الفعل قبل الفاعل: Where is the theater? في السؤال غير المباشر نعود إلى ترتيب الجملة العادي (الفاعل ثم الفعل): Can you tell me where the theater is? السؤال غير المباشر أكثر أدبًا ورسمية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: In a direct question, the verb comes before the subject: Where is the theater? In an indirect question, use normal sentence order (subject then verb): Can you tell me where the theater is? Indirect questions are more polite.

examples.word: Can you tell me where... is?
examples.sentence: Can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?

fine_lines.title: lend vs borrow
fine_lines.explanation_ar: lend = تعطي شيئًا لشخص ليستخدمه ثم يرده. borrow = تأخذ شيئًا من شخص لتستخدمه ثم ترده.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Lend = give something to someone for a short time. Borrow = take something from someone for a short time.

grammar.title: Indirect questions
grammar.explanation_ar: السؤال غير المباشر طريقة أكثر أدبًا ورسمية لطرح السؤال. يبدأ بعبارات مثل: Can/Could you tell me...؟ / Do you know...؟ / Would/Do you mind...؟ / Would it be possible...؟ بعد هذه العبارات نستخدم ترتيب الجملة العادي (فاعل + فعل) وليس ترتيب السؤال: Where is the bank? → Do you know where the bank is? مع الأسئلة التي جوابها نعم أو لا نستخدم if: Do you know if Anna will stop talking? وبعد Would you mind / Do you mind يأتي الفعل بصيغة ing: Would you mind opening that quietly?
grammar.explanation_en: Indirect questions are more polite and formal. They start with: Can/Could you tell me...? Do you know...? Would/Do you mind...? Would it be possible...? After these, use normal sentence order (subject + verb): Where is the bank? → Do you know where the bank is? For yes/no questions use if: Do you know if Anna will stop talking? After Would you mind / Do you mind, use the -ing form: Would you mind opening that quietly?
examples: Can you tell me how to get to your movie theater?
Do you mind not drinking so loudly?
Would you mind turning down your phone light?

choices: Can you tell me where is the bank?

questions.explanation_ar: في السؤال غير المباشر: الفاعل ثم الفعل (the bank is).
questions.explanation_en: Indirect questions use normal order: the bank is.
